reviews.text:
When I first brought Kimchi to ProspectBARK, I wasn’t sure what to expect. She’s an anxious pup and her previous daycare used to leave her trembling before we’d even made it through the door. One year later, I'm thrilled to say that ProspectBARK has won us both over. Every member of the staff truly loves dogs, and they shower each and every one with love, affection, and a healthy dose of allergen-free treats.

Despite being slow to warm up to strangers, Kimchi is delighted when she realizes mid-walk that we’re headed to ProspectBARK, and these days, she runs right in the second we arrive without ever looking back. It’s hard to find a doggie daycare that treats pups like they’re family and not just a business, but ProspectBARK is truly one of a kind. From the squeaky clean dog beds and hidey holes to evening storytime, everything is designed to put pets first. I’m so grateful for our new ProspectBARK family, and I know Kimchi is too!

I am a dog mumzilla and my baby boy will only stay where I think is the best place! This is it! Great care, great communication and everything is so well organised and makes me feel completely at ease leaving my baby in such great hands!! After doing loads of research around the area I couldn't be happier that I've found these guys! They're the best! THANK YOU! ❤️

ProspectBark and their team went above and beyond when we had an unexpected medical emergency with one of our dogs. They were incredibly proactive, insightful, and helpful. We’re truly grateful for their care and dedication.
This place is a lifesaver. We drop our dog off here whenever we have plans or go on a long trip. I feel safe knowing they’ve been around for a long time and vet the dogs before admitting them.
I’ve taken my dog here for baths for a few years now. They are so kind and gentle with her. And I love the sweet pictures they send during the process. Highly recommend
We'll be using you guys again real soon! This is the most peace of mind we've had while away from our two dogs in a LONG time :)

Prospect Bark has been a gift! I recently started bringing my puppy, Tucci, for daycare, and the level of care he receives is truly exceptional. The team is incredibly warm, thorough, and genuinely invested in the well-being of every dog who walks through their door.
What I love most is that their philosophy of dog care mirrors high-quality child care — attentive, structured, and deeply compassionate. It aligns perfectly with the kind of love and care that I give Tucci at home, which makes it easy to trust them and feel safe sending him there.

One of my favorite parts of the day is receiving the photos and videos they send. It’s clear from every update that Tucci is happy, engaged, and in great hands. He loves it there!

I am so grateful to have Prospect Bark in the neighborhood. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a safe, joyful, and nurturing place for their pup.

I can’t say enough good things about Prospect Bark dog walking service! I worked with them for 3 years - from day 1 when I brought puppy home until the day I moved out of state. The worst part of moving was leaving my walker and the comfort and security I felt with them! It was easy to get started and the communication from everyone was always excellent. Taryn was helpful with coordination/organization of schedules and always available to answer questions. Erik, my dog’s daily walker and best friend, is truly a gem. He cared for my dog as if she were his own and they developed a special bond over the years. He was always sweet with her and so helpful, and I loved getting notes and photos of their daily adventures. I even had neighbors in my building tell me that Erik was great with my dog. Overall the team at Prospect Bark was truly reliable and there when I needed them - for daily scheduled walks and even for care for my dog at my apartment when I was away. We miss them but could not recommend them highly enough - it’s a lucky dog that gets to walk with them next!

I am touched by the individualized care offered to my shy and insecure rescue pup.  Prospect Bark! relates to her with genuine kindness and support such that she is more confident and comfortable in the big world every day.  Thank you Prospect Bark!

Prospectbark is absolutely incredible. I’ve used them for 10 years while living in Brooklyn and have never had a single issue. Even late requests, they do absolutely everything possible to accommodate! I’ve had a bunch of different walkers/sitters and all are so kind, respectful, and genuinely care about your pet. I’ve used them for walks, overnights, feedings, and even once to get back into my apartment when I forgot my keys. They also send updates when they state they will, which is huge. I would highly, highly recommend them for all your pets needs!

We have been loyal customers of ProspectBark for 7 years with two of our dogs, and I'm so glad we found them -- they are the absolute best!! The entire team is professional, communicative, and truly cares about your animals. CS and Tina in particular are incredible.

I always feel good about leaving our dogs in their hands (not to mention, our dogs have always been so excited to run through their doors!). We really appreciate the photo and video updates while we are away.

One of our dogs is a bit anxious, and ProspectBark worked with us to ensure that he had safe, comfortable experience the first time he was boarded. They were so patient with us in the beginning, and now our dog is obsessed with going to Prospect Bark. The space is huge and clean, and it's nice to have peace of mind knowing that your animals will be loved and cared for while you're away.

We are moving out of the city, and we are so sad to have to leave Prospect Bark. We're so grateful to them and would recommend them to anyone looking for caring, trustworthy, pet care!

We have used Prospect Bark for over 15 years with 3 dogs and 2 cats and could not recommendthem more highly for both walking and overnight stays. They are incredibly professional, always on time, and it is very easy to schedule whatever you need. Most importantly, they LOVE pets! They always make sure that the pet and the walker/carer have good chemistry before any stay. We have never felt the need to seek another carer, after years of switching.

This is the best day care I have come across. Communicative, clear, sweet, and thoughtful. I feel confident leaving our dog here for the day or when we go on vacation for weeks at a time. CS, the owner, is the real deal. She knows dogs and her staff is as responsive as she is. I am so impressed and feel grateful to have this resource at our disposal.

We mentioned it was our dog’s birthday and they gave him a bandana and a ball. So silly but so thoughtful and sweet when they could have just done nothing.

Also the outdoor area is so important and hard to find in NYC. We never feel like our dog is stressed out by the commotion of other dogs or confines of the indoor area. He has his own cubby with his picture on it. Can not express how appreciative I am of this business. Highly recommend

These folks care about your pet as much as you do. They shared lots of photos and details about the visit while I was away, which made me feel good about the care my cat was getting. Would definitely recommend the cat sitting!!

Prospect Bark has been wonderful for us and our new puppy! They have supported us every step of the way from early training, socializing, daycare (when she was ready!), and overnight stays. Our dog loves PB and has made friends and improved her manners due to their kind, caring, and consistent environment. We can’t recommend them enough!

Amazing daycare. They go above and beyond to take care of their animals, ensuring they are playing safely and in a fulfilling manner. They are extremely communicative. Chun Soon is next level. I am so happy to be part of the puppy family!

We have been taking our puppy to ProspectBark for almost a year, and we absolutely adore it. The staff is incredible! They have a very thorough communication system, screening process to ensure the dogs are a good fit for social environments, and their online portal makes booking easy, while also ensuring all of the dogs are up to date on the required vaccines. This rigor and effort Chun-Soon and her team put into the business provides so much comfort to us as owners, as we know our girl is being well looked after, in a safe and healthy environment. Getting to see her having a blast with her friends via the daily videos and photos the team sends is amazing. I would highly recommend anyone with a pet bring them to ProspectBark - they are the best doggy daycare I have ever experienced - and they really love and care about the dogs. Our pup Milly drags us there as soon as we get close and can't wait to go in - which is the best review you can get :)

We’ve been bringing our dog Bari to ProspectBArk Daycare for about a year now, and it has been a truly wonderful experience from day one. The staff—especially Tina and the owner Chun Soon—are kind, gentle, and deeply attentive. They’ve created a nurturing, structured environment that makes both pups and their humans feel like part of the family.

Bari is a social dog who loves meeting and playing with other dogs, and this has proven to be the perfect place for him to thrive. As a rescue, he's more cautious with people, but over time, he’s grown comfortable with the staff. He’ll now sniff their hands and even accept some pets, all on his own terms. I really appreciate how the team respects each dog’s pace and personality.

They also go above and beyond with special events like their Winter Wonderland Pawty and Lunar New Year celebration. Since Bari is from South Korea, the Lunar New Year Pawty was especially meaningful—he got to wear a special outfit, eat a delicious vegan moon cake, and celebrate with other Asian-origin pups.

The two-phase evaluation process shows how seriously they take compatibility and safety. I felt confident right away that Bari was in good hands, and the daily updates, photos, and videos are always a joy to receive.

Whether it's for a regular daycare day or a longer overnight staycation, ProspectBArk gives us total peace of mind. Every daycare morning, Bari wakes up excited and can’t wait to get through their doors. I’m so grateful for this wonderful community and highly recommend them to anyone looking for loving, expert care for their pup.

Prospect Bark is the very best pet sitting/ walking company hands down! My family has been using them for 12 years and counting and they are the most reliable, kind, supportive, communicative and animal loving we have ever worked with. Ben Quesnell is A+++. His commitment to our animals over the years (dog, cats, hermit crab) has been so awesome, I cannot say enough good about them. If you need a great pet sitting company you can rely on, look no further!

Update: they were good but had to downgrade my vote since they do not always separate large and small dogs even though they have separate sections. My dog is good with most dogs but plays rough with little ones and is big. I recommended they separate him and they would rather ban him. For charging as much as they do they should know how to handle dogs of different play temperaments.

Where do I begin with Prospect Bark and how incredibly amazing they are. Staff: the owner of Prospect Bark and her team are beyond the best.  They love all of the dogs as if they were their own.  They provide individual time, attention and love to every dog. They are so attentive from managing diets and allergies and any medicine to play time, etc. they send us videos and photos all day that are just the best. Environment: I would like to stay for a day at Prospect Bark it is so calming and relaxing.  They have high ceilings, calming music, clean - very clear they are constantly cleaning because it smells lovely - and they have beds and toys for all dog sizes - including heated blankets in their front window during the winter and a big play space and pools in their yard. Boarding: our dog loves boarding at Prospect Bark.  Their lower level is a combo of Murphy beds for free sleeping dogs and crates for dogs who need crate sleeping. They have staff who sat over with the dogs which is just the best. Care: everything from little personal hand-drawn pics of the dogs on the walls to “pupsicles” in the summer to Thanksgiving dinner and a holiday photo shoot, Prospect Bark is beyond like family to us and our dog.  We love them and everything they do and have recommended them to many.  They are exceptional! Beyond highly recommend!!

The team at ProsepctBARK is one of the most conscientious and caring group of animal care specialists we have ever encountered. From the early days of the business when they walked
our bulldog puppy to the their sensitive and meticulous care for her late in life - this team loves animals and makes it their mission to provide amazing services. We now have two new puppies and two cats. ProspectBARK provide excellent in home and day care services for all of our animals. They are like family to us and our animals and always exhibit professional excellence. Creative (draw up dog days!) unique (summertime frozen treats) and deeply kind - our animals are in the very best hands with this wonderful team!

Best doggie daycare, boarding, sitting and walking in Brooklyn! My wife and I have been using ProspectBArk! since our dog (now 8 years) was 3 months old. We've done daily walking (for several years before covid), in-home sitting, daycare …

Prospect Bark is awesome!!  If you love your dog you won’t board them anywhere else! I have searched many dog boarding places in Park Slope, and Prospect Bark is the absolute best by far! Chun-Soon and her daughter, Tina, Sheila and the …

I cannot say enough good things about prospect bark. We send our dog to day care and board her, and she is treated with so much love and care. ProspectBark has also helped her become socialized well with dogs, and they’ve been so collaborative. We are so grateful to have found prospect bark.

ProspectBArk goes above and beyond for pets and their humans! They have been kitty sitting for us for years when we go on vacation, and we have only ever had positive experiences. Sitters are always professional, communicative, and provide …
